subject: microbiology
title: Haemophilus ducreyi, Chancroid and Bordetella pertussis

steps.tx: **Haemophilus ducreyi** causes **chancroid**: painful soft genital ulcers with undermined edges and tender suppurative bubo, school of fish chains of coccobacilli on gram stain, X factor only on enriched chocolate with serum, fastidious and undercultured beside NAAT, facilitating HIV transmission, distinguished from syphilis hard painless chancre and herpes grouped vesicles.
steps.say: Painful soft ulcer plus tender bubo leans chancroid; painless hard leans syphilis.

left.title: Chancroid portrait
points: Geography: focal tropics, outbreaks in sex networks

right.title: Ulcer differentials
points: Herpes: grouped vesicles recurrent painful shallow
LGV: transient ulcer then grooved buboes

steps.tx: **Ducreyi laboratory reality**: culture sensitivity poor (special enriched media, CO2, within hours), PCR multiplex genital ulcer panels better (ducreyi, syphilis, HSV together), gram stain school of fish suggestive insensitive, treatment syndromic (azithromycin single dose or ceftriaxone) with HIV testing, partners treated and bubo aspirated through healthy skin rather than incised.
steps.say: Treat the ulcer syndrome and test all three authors; culture ducreyi rarely cooperates.

left.title: Diagnosis stack
points: Dark field and syphilis serology parallel
Culture media (Mueller Hinton chocolate serum) reference

right.title: Treatment stack
points: Azithromycin 1 g single or ceftriaxone IM
HIV and syphilis follow up testing

steps.tx: **Bordetella pertussis** is a tiny gram negative coccobacillus, strictly aerobic, causing whooping cough via tracheal cytotoxin, pertussis toxin and adenylate cyclase toxin paralysing cilia and lymphocytes, Bordet Gengou culture heritage (next lesson), PCR now diagnosis, catarrhal then paroxysmal then convalescent stages over weeks (hundred day cough).
steps.say: Pertussis toxins paralyse cilia and the cough outlives the bacterium by weeks.

vis.alt: Pertussis pathogenesis and laboratory findings diagram
vis.caption: Pertussis pathogenesis and laboratory pattern, lymphocytosis and toxin effects.

steps.tx: **Pertussis portraits by age**: infants apnoea, cyanosis and pneumonia (lethal, pertussis toxin lymphocytosis clogging lungs severe), older children paroxysms, whoop, post tussive vomiting, adults prolonged bronchitis without whoop infecting infants. Maternal Tdap in pregnancy shields first months before infant doses.
steps.say: Infants stop breathing instead of whooping; pregnancy vaccination guards that gap.

left.title: Infant disease
points: ICU and exchange transfusion debates extreme

right.title: Older disease
points: Macrolide early shortens infectiousness, late little symptom change

steps.tx: **Pertussis diagnosis and reporting**: nasopharyngeal PCR (posterior, Dacron) in first three weeks, culture Bordet Gengou or Regan Lowe gold standard slow and specific, serology anti PT IgG for late adolescents and adults, case notification and macrolide prophylaxis for infant and pregnancy contacts.
steps.say: Swab the posterior nasopharynx early for PCR; late cough is serology country.

left.title: Test windows
points: Serology after 2 weeks (not infants, vaccine confounds)

right.title: Control
points: Droplet isolation 5 days antibiotics (or 21 days untreated)

steps.tx: **Pertussis vaccines** (whole cell effective reactogenic heritage, acellular multi antigen current, waning immunity and baboon transmission data debates) still prevent severe infant disease best via maternal immunisation and timely series; resurgence maps to waning plus coverage gaps rather than vaccine failure alone.
steps.say: Acellular vaccines protect infants best through their mothers and on time doses.

right.title: Programme answers
points: Outbreak macrolide and exclusion protocols schools

steps.tx: **Bordetella kin**: parapertussis milder whoop (no pertussis toxin), bronchiseptica animal respiratory opportunist in immunocompromised, holmesii blood culture confusion with pertussis PCR cross targets. Species matter because vaccine and control differ.
steps.say: Parapertussis whoops without toxin; pertussis PCR targets can cross holmesii.

steps.tx: **Genital ulcer algorithms** close ducreyi's module: syphilis tests always (coexistence), HIV offer, HSV PCR, chancroid and LGV and donovanosis geography, partner windows by organism, and repeat syphilis serology at follow up because first visit can be window. Documenting ulcer healing is important because treatment failure may signal herpes, syphilis or antimicrobial resistance rather than chancroid.
steps.say: One ulcer, four tests and two visits: ulcer work is a system, not a swab.
